description: This file defines the ConvertToDpQuickFix class, which implements an Android lint quick fix to convert pixel (px) values to density-independent pixels (dp) in Android XML layout files.

classes.name: ConvertToDpQuickFix
classes.description: Implements an Android lint quick fix to convert px values to dp in XML layout files.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the quick fix by converting px attributes and text values to dp based on user-selected density.

methods.name: convertToDp
methods.description: Converts a px value string to dp based on the specified density.

methods.name: getLabelForDensity
methods.description: Returns a display label for a given density.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the quick fix is applicable in the current context.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the quick fix.
